# agyn_private_resource (Resource)

Manages an Agyn private resource exposed through a private network.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `intercept_host` (String) Hostname agents use to reach the private resource.
- `intercept_ports` (List of Number) Intercept ports agents use to reach the private resource.
- `name` (String) Private resource name.
- `network_id` (String) Private network identifier.
- `protocol` (String) Private resource protocol. One of `tcp`, `http`, or `https`.
- `target_host` (String) Private target host reached by the operator-run tunneler.
- `target_ports` (List of Number) Private target ports.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID identifier of the private resource.
- `organization_id` (String) Organization identifier for the private resource.
- `provisioning_state` (String) OpenZiti provisioning state.
